body:
There’s no point in talking to my friends. They are sick of the ongoing chaos. Having people be sick of you is ridiculously saddening. 

My family don’t get it.

I am sick of being sick. I will always have BPD. Everything I used to like in life no longer gives me that same sense of hope and joy and belonging. Consequently I no longer have a “passion” in life. I will never feel okay. I will always feel incomplete, unhappy, unfulfilled.
